text:
ops-oncall: Pagerduty alert — sudden auth success/fail pattern + sustained high rps to /v1/embeddings from a cluster of proxies, spike started ~1748205200. looks like credential-spray + scraping mixed. kicking this off here.

pagerduty-bot: [Alert] high auth failure rate (P1) — 12,300 failures/min, 85% from 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24.

ops-oncall: quick facts: embeddings rps x6 baseline, 429s and 403s increasing, tail latency up for low-priority customers. no obvious upstream infra errors.

sre-ana: I can take primary. printing live queries for top ips -> `tcpdump -n -A host 203.0.113.12 or host 198.51.100.21`

sec-mark: enabling WAF rate limiting rule for suspicious cidr blocks now. will add tarpit for login endpoints.

ops-oncall: apply rule id waf-rule-8675: block if requests > 40/s from same /24 for /v1/auth and /v1/embeddings. exec: `curl -X POST https://waf.internal/rules -d '{"id":"waf-rule-8675","action":"tarpit","match":"/v1/auth","threshold":40,"scope":"/24"}'`

sam: Confirmed pushed. WAF reports: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24 hit tarpit. initial RPS from those fell ~70%.

cx-lead: Which customers are in the affected tail? Need list for comms.

ops-oncall: running query now -> `SELECT customer_id FROM requests WHERE path LIKE '/v1/embeddings%' AND ip IN (...)` sending list in a sec.

ops-oncall: short list: cust-5922 (low-priority), cust-8801 (trial), cust-11223 (internal partner). none appear to be high-tier prod.

sre-ana: Because embeddings were spiking, I disabled async batch ingestion for public endpoints: `POST /admin/feature-flags` -> `{"embedding_batching":false}`. This will reduce throughput pressure.

sec-mark: also adding a per-API-key short quota slice: for keys with >100req/min -> cut to 10req/min and require captcha on auth. Patch pushed to quota-service: `PATCH /quotas?selector=key_rate>100`

ops-oncall: quota change deployed, metrics show 50% drop in abusive client RPS within 3m.

sam: noticed some 502s at edge after WAF change, looks transient. rolling restart edge-proxy pod 3 on eu-west-2 to clear stuck conns. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n prod --field-selector spec.template.metadata.name=edge-proxy`

incident-bot: oncall handoff: @sre-ana is primary, @ops-oncall secondary. Pager escalation suppressed.

cx-lead: Drafting a short customer note for impacted trials: "We've detected increased automated activity affecting some trial accounts. We've applied protective limits; if your application is impacted, reply and we'll review." Posting in #customer-notices after SRE confirms no false positives.

ops-oncall: quick check: any false-positive flags? @sre-ana?

sre-ana: ran heuristics on payloads — high entropy pattern + repeated login attempts with different usernames, definitely credential stuffing + scraping. low fp risk.

sec-mark: pushing a WAF soft-block for other suspect ranges: 192.0.2.0/24 and 203.0.113.128/25, adding challenge (captcha) for /v1/auth.

ops-oncall: putting temporary dynamic quota cap: global burst cap down to 1.5x baseline for 30m. config: `traffic-shaper set --global-burst 1.5 --duration 30m`

sam: customer impact: trial churn visible in dashboards for cust-8801, but they were sending huge batches repeatedly. CX ok with short block but wants to ensure we don't block legit devs.

cx-lead: agree. we'll send message and monitor replies for 60m before escalating comms.

ops-oncall: monitoring GA: latency leaf now back to normal for tiered customers, embeddings cost per-token trending down.

sre-ana: collecting logs for RCA: saving top 500 IPs and request samples to s3://incidents/1748205310/ for forensics.

sec-mark: recommend follow-up: add rate-limiting rule to onboarding keys (restrict initial key to 50req/min) and require progressive increase. Filing PR for policy change.

ops-oncall: handoff to night oncall in 45m. If no regressions, we'll de-escalate and close thread.

sam: noted. saving current mitigation checklist to incident ticket INC-17482.

cx-lead: posted customer note to #customer-notices and linked to INC-17482.

ops-oncall: last update before handoff: WAF + quota slices + batch disable reduced abusive RPS by ~88%. No high-tier customer impact observed. leaving monitoring and contact list with night oncall.

sre-ana: leaving heartbeat checks: `/health/embeddings` alert threshold lowered for 1h. will follow up with postmortem tomorrow.

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated, monitoring.

ops-oncall: handing off. @night-oncall please take over, see INC-17482 and S3 folder.

pagerduty-bot: escalation cleared.

night-oncall: acked, taking over. ping if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
